inputs.name: hand over from Training Pipeline to Experiment Tracking

output.level_0: Experiment records vanish when the training pipeline crashes, leaving no trace of failed model runs.
output.level_1: No experiment tracking exists, so retraining results are lost unless someone manually saves a spreadsheet.
output.level_2: A data scientist manually copies metrics from the training log into a shared document after each run.
output.level_3: The training pipeline automatically logs every experiment run and its metrics to a central tracking system.
output.level_4: Experiment tracking is governed, with access controls and audit logs for every model evaluation and decision.
